name: A King's Tribute
summary: A King's Tribute marks the final step in honoring the sacrifice of the fallen dwarven soldier Sully Balloo. After fine granite is gathered from the ruins of Lordaeron, Grand Mason Marblesten sculpts a solemn memorial monument in Ironforge on the orders of King Magni Bronzebeard.

sections.title: A Monument Carved in Grief
sections.body: King Magni Bronzebeard commissioned a permanent monument to honor Sully Balloo, a brave dwarf who lost his life in service to his people. Crafted by Grand Mason Marblesten using high-quality granite transported from the war-torn lands of Lordaeron, the finished memorial stands in Ironforge as an enduring testament to fallen soldiers whose sacrifices preserve the dwarven kingdom.

sections.title: A Sovereign's Reflection
sections.body: When presented with news of the monument's completion, Magni reflects somberly on the limits of stone and mortality. While acknowledging that carved rock can never truly equate to a brave dwarf's life, he hopes the memorial endures so future generations walking Azeroth will never forget the heroes who bled to secure their tomorrow.

faq.q: Who is being honored by this memorial?
faq.answer: The monument is built in memory of Sully Balloo, a brave dwarven soldier who gave his life fighting valiantly for his people and the Alliance.

faq.q: Why was the stone gathered from Lordaeron?
faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten required the finest granite suitable for a lasting royal tribute. Lordaeron produces exceptional quarried stone, even though the region itself has fallen into ruin following the Scourge.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: The quest begins with Grand Mason Marblesten and finishes with King Magni Bronzebeard in the High Seat of Ironforge.

faq.q: Why does King Magni commission this tribute personally?
faq.answer: Magni believes that rulers must honor the foot soldiers who defend their realms. He views memorial stone as a vital reminder to future generations of the high price paid by common soldiers for their safety.

faq.q: What happens after the memorial is finished?
faq.answer: Reporting to King Magni concludes the memorial chain. The crafted statue remains in Ironforge as a solemn, permanent landmark for Sully Balloo.

faq.q: What is the masonry significance of the statue?
faq.answer: Grand Mason Marblesten is among the most accomplished dwarven artisans in Ironforge. Working the imported Lordaeron granite, he shaped the raw stone into a fitting national work of art on the monarch's behalf.

angles.text: For dwarves, honoring ancestral fallen warriors in enduring stone is one of their most sacred cultural traditions.
The monument serves as a poignant reminder of the heavy toll exacted across Khaz Modan and the northern kingdoms during recent conflicts.
Magni's words directly honor the selfless valor of frontline soldiers like Sully Balloo who sacrificed everything in battle.
